## <br>`r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "Selected Ground-Motion Suite<br>Pseudo-Spectral Acceleration"`

```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAPTION", inherits = FALSE)) {
  Site <- .reportLabel()
  Site <- if (nzchar(Site)) {
    sprintf(" at %s", Site)
  } else if (exists("params", inherits = FALSE) && !is.null(params$site)) {
    sprintf(" at %s", params$site)
  } else {
    ""
  }
  CAPTION <- sprintf(readCaption("fig.srs.psa"), Site)
  rm(Site)
}
```
